_role: 七种安全算法全部使用 段线（segment）约束 的版本：PDM App.C.3 圆-线段行被同时用作其余六种的约束实现（声明为 task-adapted segment variant）。行数约 46k/样本，单样本预期分钟级。

adaptations.state: native 128-point trajectory (2 endpoints pinned). No B-spline, no control mapping: constraints are evaluated on the delivered object itself.
adaptations.model: SafetyPointDiffuser (5.3958 M): current v4 1-layer scene encoder + 8-layer final denoiser + S-C48 safety-geometry branch (candidate-anchored ellipse queries). Trained 100 epochs at T=256, docs/native_point_retrain_report.md.
adaptations.schedule: T=256 native; cd_levels=256 means every trained level is visited once (eq.(6) uses that level's own beta_t).
adaptations.pdm_step_convention: official_ald with eps derived so that gamma/sigma^2 = 1/6 (the paper form gives a mixing rate of 1/(2 sigma_T^2), i.e. no movement on this schedule).
adaptations.pdm_inner: 20 instead of M=100 (PDM App. F permits reducing M).
adaptations.segment_constraints_for: 2026-11-14 按论文口径全部用段线约束：用户指出“点都在空地、线横穿墙”，实测 61001/74014 上 Projected 与 PDM 都是 0/128 坏点但线段穿墙。segment 版本每样本约束行 128 -> 46355（128 段 x 362 圆）。
adaptations.cbf: dt=1 per level, 16 sub-steps, per-point step cap, discrete certificate per level with bounded retry.
adaptations.timeouts: The safety base costs ~40 ms per forward (skeleton branch), so the loops are ~2.7x the point-model cost; timeouts raised to 1800 s (3600 s for PDM) to keep solver budget, not speed, the binding constraint.
adaptations.pdm_ald_eps: T=256 口径：eps 由 gamma/sigma^2=1/6 反算 => eps = 2*sigma_min^2/6 = 6.2954e-05（误用 T=16 的 4.003e-3 会让混合率大 6.4 倍，实测 SGLD 直接发散：长度比 103、rmse 107 m）。

validation_selection: Frozen20 equally spaced validation indices, the same 20 scenes as every earlier table.
